response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, hands-on engineer with 14+ years of experience across web, backend, mobile and embedded systems, meeting the baseline requirements for years of experience, a CS degree, and proficiency in relevant languages (JavaScript/TypeScript, C/C++, Java, C#). He has genuine high-scale, low-latency exposure at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby and strong engineering-craft credentials (TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, teaching and conference talks). However, the resume shows essentially no experience with the core of this role: experimentation frameworks, A/B testing quality and bias detection, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics platforms, or growth measurement. There is also little evidence of Principal/IC6-level scope — multi-workstream leadership across teams and products, architecture ownership at enterprise scale, or data science partnership. He is a strong generalist engineer but a weak match for a specialized growth/experimentation systems principal role; worth a screening call only if the team is willing to hire for platform-building fundamentals and train on experimentation.
strengths: 14+ years across full stack, with high-throughput low-latency systems experience (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Strong software-craft fundamentals: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, testing tooling and mentoring/workshops
Broad language coverage matching the JD (TypeScript/JS, C/C++, Java, C#) plus AI-agent/developer-tooling work
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging or growth-measurement platform experience
Little evidence of Principal/IC6 scope: cross-team architecture ownership, multi-workstream leadership, stakeholder influence
Limited data/statistics and telemetry-infrastructure depth; mostly product/startup-scale rather than enterprise distributed systems

key_factors.factor: Insufficient evidence of principal-level scope and cross-org technical leadership
Deep, broad engineering experience with high-scale service work
